{{Quote|Tell me&hellip;and my life may depend on your answer&hellip;do I have time for a sanisteam? We were on that blasted shuttle for longer than I want to think about. I don't dare sit down. I might stick.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
A '''sanisteam''' was a type of [[Bath/Legends|bath]] or [[Shower/Legends|shower]] that was used for personal hygiene and sanitation. They were usually found in a [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]]. They were in common use on both [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]] and beyond.

Sanisteam technology could also be utilized in other applications, such as the cleaning of a ship's interior. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] longed to have a hot sanisteam after spending a very long mission in the confines of her [[StealthX]].
